title: /ask: a foreign-tenant (or foreign-source) vector chunk that references an excluded turn is silently dropped instead of refusing the request
area: apps/api/src/ask/source-context.ts createSourceHydrator, the snapshot.chunks filter that runs BEFORE validateChunk
evidence: Probe with a poisoned db: turns [valid, own tEnd<tStart], chunks [{tenantId:'other', sourceRef:<admitted>, turnRefs:[<excluded turn id>]}], embed supplied: hydration RESOLVES (chunk dropped); without the excluded turn it would throw 'invalid scoped vector evidence'. ROW-level scope is correct: 7 probes (foreign tenant or session row that also has tEnd<tStart, NaN, negative, empty id, non-string text, or a shared excluded id) all REFUSE. No data leaks (the chunk is discarded), but the rule that foreign-tenant evidence always refuses does not hold for chunks.
fix_direction: Run validateChunk (tenant, sourceRef, shape) on every chunk first, tolerating only the case where turnRefs point at an excluded turn, then drop. Add a test with a foreign-tenant chunk covering an excluded turn expecting BoundedAskError.

title: Two mutation survivors: NaN tStart accepted by scripts/lib/turn-timing.mjs, and negative tStart not excluded in /ask rowProblem
evidence: Mutation 1: drop Number.isFinite(tStart) in scripts/lib/turn-timing.mjs (NaN tStart then passes: tStart<0 and tEnd<tStart are both false) under turn-timing + legacy-unbound + session-rows tests: SURVIVED. Mutation 2: remove the tStart<0 branch in rowProblem under source-exclusion + turn-timing-write tests: SURVIVED. The code is correct today; the criteria are unasserted. The other 8 mutations were killed.
fix_direction: Add NaN tStart and Infinity cases to turn-timing.test.mjs, and a tStart -1 case to source-exclusion.test.ts.

title: packages/ask/src/source-context.ts now contains raw NUL bytes (excludedKeys separator), so git treats it as binary and the diff is unreviewable
evidence: git diff shows 'Binary files differ'; git show HEAD:... | file reports data; 172 lines contain a 0x00 byte; the base blob was text.
fix_direction: Use the escape \u0000 or a JSON.stringify([sessionId, turnId]) key instead of a literal NUL.
